source.title: Forebears Malawi forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to keep localized sample names. This is not an official civil registry export; gender grouping remains a review seed.

source.title: ITU Malawi national numbering plan communication of 11.XII.2017

phones.notes: ITU/MACRA confirms country code +265, nine-digit national significant numbers, and the 88 SIM-based TNM range. Other possible mobile ranges are intentionally omitted until added from a current public allocation source.

source.title: UPU Postal Addressing Systems: member-country address structures

locations.notes: UPU confirms the postal-addressing reference source and Malawi postcode structure. Region, city and street samples are public-geography review data; postalPrefixes are generator prefixes rather than complete postcodes.

national_identity_number.label: National Identity Number

source.title: Malawi National Registration Bureau national ID overview

national_identity_number.notes: Official NRB material confirms the National ID and a unique identification number, QR code and MRZ, but no public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. NID is a generator marker, not a claimed card prefix.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: Malawi e-Passport type and numbering-prefix factsheet

passport.notes: Official embassy factsheet states ordinary passport numbering prefixes MWAxxxxxx for 36 pages and MWZxxxxxx for 48 pages. Values are synthetic and not registry-validated.

personal_number.label: Passport Personal Number

source.title: PRADO Malawi ordinary passport document entries

personal_number.notes: Reviewed public specimen context supports this as a sample-level visual pattern only. No official rule or cross-document internal logic was found.
